column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a18 -- a17 with the fix of the C compile of fe170j (every module translated; gcc refused
# frontend.c:172016/172020/172029 "invalid type argument of '->' (have 'L2ValueSpan')": lm_compiler_lifted_defer read the by-value span
# member of the actual through a second step): the span's address is taken into a local pointer first, as the module does elsewhere.
# The a17 fix: the const body of lm_compiler_merge_scan cast at the call of lm_compiler_merge_lift. The a16 fix: the four field accesses
# passed as arguments in the new lower functions cast. The a15 fixes: the locals and parameters named node renamed at, the local call of
# lm_compiler_merge_lift_find renamed appl. The a14 fix: a duplicated condition line in lm_compiler_whole_decide removed. The a13 fixes:
# the LIFTED and DEFERRED marks on the frame flag bits 65536 and 131072, merge rejected as a call head, the hidden declaration name
# allocated zeroed and no trailer written on the hidden body, the four helper functions exported in tools/build.lm2 (frontend_names 264).
# The remainders of the review of Codex over a11 (a12): the hold of the overlapping readings (whole_overlap_held), the names and the form of
# a whole call before the actual in both executors (lmx_call_bind_whole_form), the merge written in the call itself lifted into a hidden
# declaration (THEN operand 66, OP_COUNT 67), the applicability by the Consumer-relative projection with the conversion table. The kernel,
# the driver and tools/build.lm2 unchanged since a13 (tool170d and rt170e stay). Run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a.
